signal: Phosphorus Cybersecurity was acquired by industrial cybersecurity firm Dragos in June 2026 to strengthen xIoT and OT device security

email.body1:
Jeff, saw Dragos acquired Phosphorus this month to deepen its xIoT and OT device security reach.

An acquisition like that usually opens more accounts in play than the team can cover while the combined motion settles, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Phosphorus off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jeff, quick follow-up for Phosphorus.

Post-acquisition, cross-sell and coverage expectations usually jump faster than the team can keep up. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Phosphorus needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jeff, last bit of proof for Phosphorus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Phosphorus' reply rate likely compares to other cybersecurity teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jeff, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and right after an acquisition the team is usually heads-down on integration.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an xIoT security motion? I will tailor it to Phosphorus either way.
